episodes.synopsis: A re-edited version of America's Cleaning Of The Storage, done as a full episode. First aired as a special between seasons 2 and 3, and later included on the Hetalia Fan Disc.
episodes.title: America's Cleaning of the Storage: Director's Cut

episodes.synopsis: A special unaired episode included on the Hetalia Fan Disc. Continues the story of Prussia and Hungary as kids from the first episode of Hetalia: World Series.
episodes.title: Episode 53.5: The Diary of the Awesome Me (2)

episodes.synopsis: A re-edited version of the Chibitalia segments from the first season done as a full episode. Included on the Hetalia Fan Disc.
episodes.title: Chibitalia

episodes.synopsis: Iceland meets up with the rest of the Nordic states to reveal the results of a test to find out who his ancestors were.
episodes.title: The Indigenous People of Iceland?

episodes.synopsis: The countries of the world celebrate Halloween. Also, Italy and Germany reminisce about old times.
episodes.title: Today is Halloween

episodes.synopsis: China worries about the other nations of the world trying to invade his land and get his opium. America uses a 1942 notebook computer to calculate a route from America to Germany. Also features adaptation of "Previously in Hetalia".
episodes.title: The Story So Far

episodes.synopsis: The episode adapts the plot of the Drama CD Hetalia Fantasia. The Axis and the Allies take a small trip inside a Role-Playing Game.
episodes.title: Hetalia = Fantasia

episodes.synopsis: Germany may be a good strategist, but he isn't very good at reading emotions. So naturally, when he questions the nature of his and Italy's relationship, things get a bit...complicated.
episodes.title: Buon San Valentino (1)

episodes.synopsis: Things quickly become tangled as Germany tries to sort out his "feelings" for Italy. As it turns out, Italy and Germany's thoughts aren't exactly in alignment.
episodes.title: Buon San Valentino (2)

episodes.synopsis: It's America's two-hundredth birthday, and England finally plucks up the courage to do something nice for him.
episodes.title: The Centennial Gift

episodes.synopsis: Liechtenstein wonders what her big brother Switzerland does during the war.
episodes.title: Liechtenstein and the Hedgehog Country

episodes.synopsis: Estonia falls asleep during a World Meeting one day and is shocked to find that all of the nations have been turned into girls.
episodes.title: I Was Overwhelmed by Heroines

episodes.synopsis: Germany talks about living with Austria.
episodes.title: Germany and Cohabitation

episodes.synopsis: Netherlands attempts to make Japan open up to the outside world a little.
episodes.title: Netherlands and Isolationist Japan

episodes.synopsis: As they prepare for battle against Lithuania and Poland, Finland tells Sweden a story about a battle between Poland and Lithuania and the Teutonic Knights.
episodes.title: The Ruler of Scandinavia and The King of Eastern Europe

episodes.synopsis: America hosts a grand Halloween party, but the party features a costume contest!? England was the only one who didn't know about the contest, and the reason is....
episodes.title: Surprise Halloween!
